name: Sant Ignasi
description: A country house from 1777 north of Ciutadella, on the way to Cala Morell, turned into a rural hotel with a garden pool, tennis and padel courts and massage service. Classic and unshowy: the traditional finca, well run, ten minutes from the old town.

practicalInfo.acceso: North of Ciutadella, towards Cala Morell.
practicalInfo.horario: Check the season and dates on the official website.
practicalInfo.servicios: Outdoor pool, gardens, tennis and padel, massages, parking.

seo.description: Sant Ignasi, Ciutadella: a 1777 country house turned rural hotel with pool, tennis and gardens, near Cala Morell.
